title: Family wellness retreat in March (Help me choose)
request: I want to go on a trip with my family over spring, March 19-29. Preferably a nice retreat. I want to feel good because life has been stressful recently. Outdoors stuff.

4 bases, Vík í Mýrdal, Höfn, Akureyri, Reykjavík: the moves cost about 18 h 15 in all. It takes these stays to follow the route. The hotel changes you allow cannot follow the whole route: Egilsstaðir is beyond a day's reach of where you stay.

4 bases, Vík í Mýrdal, Höfn, Akureyri, Reykjavík: the moves cost about 17 h 20 in all. It takes these stays to follow the route. The hotel changes you allow cannot follow the whole route: Egilsstaðir is beyond a day's reach of where you stay.

2 days are lighter than they should be: Sidequest could not put 6 of the places it found on the map. That is Sidequest's to fix — nothing for you to do.

A short walk up to the village church gives a wide view over Vík and the sea stacks.

Þingvellir National Park
70 min by car — further than you said you would usually go, but a strong enough fit that it earns the extra travel.
III · DAY 8
National Museum of Iceland
A thorough overview of Icelandic history, good for a rainy start or end day.
